chunks: They will hear no nonsense there or talk of sin,

key_terms.تَأْثِيمًا: Sin, wrongdoing, or cause of sin

ai.seo_question: What kind of speech is absent in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the complete elimination of *laghw* (vain talk) and *ta'thim* (sinful wrongdoing) as a divine guarantee for the purified souls of the believers. It reflects the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) extended to the inhabitants of Paradise, where their speech and actions are naturally aligned with divine will, free from any distraction or error.
